subject: Clearline Health — renewal discussion: onboarding credit, short-term price corridor, and capacity bump
messages:
From: Joel Park <joel.park@clearlinehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — credits & short-term pricing ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team and I are aligned on moving forward, but we ran into two procurement constraints that will affect the renewal:

- PO timing: our finance org will not sign a renewed multi-year PO until the quarter closes (end of May). That pushes our onboarding/invoice timing at least 6 weeks later than what we expected.
- Near-term capacity: we expect a 2x uplift in inference consumption for a pilot in July and need to lock capacity guidance soon.

Given those constraints, can Redwood offer: 1) a short-term price corridor (12 weeks) that preserves our current committed rate for the first X tokens, and 2) a one-time onboarding credit to offset the invoice being pushed to the next billing window? If you can share a proposal we can route to procurement.

Appreciate a clear summary (numbers + PO language) we can include in the purchase request.

Best,
Joel Park
Head of Product, Clearline Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joel Park <joel.park@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — credits & short-term pricing ask

Joel — thanks for the clear summary. We can accommodate both asks with a narrow set of guardrails. High level proposal (see attached PDF for math):

1) Short-term price corridor: 12-week price hold on current committed unit rates for up to your existing commit (baseline tokens). Any incremental consumption above baseline during the corridor billed at published overage rate.

2) Onboarding credit: one-time credit of $25,000 applied to first invoice after PO is received. Credit is intended to offset the delayed invoice timing you described.

3) Capacity uplift path: we’ll provision a temporary burst pool (no change to long-term commit) to support a 2x pilot in July. If you want to convert that burst into a permanent commit, we can flip into a phased true-up with a 3-month notice window and pro-rated pricing.

Conditions we need from procurement for the corridor/credit:
- PO referencing deal id CL-2027-089 or DocuSign packet we’ll send (no new SOW needed).
- Payment terms remain net-30 from invoice date. Credit applied against first paid invoice in the renewal term.
- Corridor is timebound (12 weeks) and non-renewing unless we agree to extend.

I’ve attached a short proposal and the onboarding credit calc. If this looks reasonable I’ll loop in Ben (revops) and Lauren (sales lead) to finalize the DocuSign packet.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com; lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-04T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Clearline — ask for one-time onboarding credit and 12-week price corridor (details)

Ben / Lauren — quick ask: Clearline (CL-2027-089) needs a one-time onboarding credit of $25k and a 12-week price corridor at their current committed unit rates to bridge a delayed PO. They also want a temporary 2x burst pool for July.

Proposal I’m planning to send to procurement (summary):
- Credit: $25,000, applied to first invoice after PO.
- Corridor: 12 weeks price hold at existing commit level (baseline tokens only).
- Burst pool: temporary allocation, billed as capacity-on-demand; conversion into commit requires 3-month notice and will be pro-rated.

If we approve the credit, I’ll prepare the DocuSign packet and include explicit PO language so procurement can forward without legal loops. Need Ben’s verbal sign-off for $25k credit and Lauren’s approval on the concession playbook.

Can you confirm by EOD so we can keep momentum?

Thanks — Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com; lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-04T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Clearline — ask for one-time onboarding credit and 12-week price corridor (details)

Soojin — good summary. Approve the $25k one-time onboarding credit as a customer success/sales enablement concession (one-off). Approve the 12-week corridor with the condition we include clear overage language and an expiration date. Finance will need the final DocuSign packet to set invoice and credit application timing.

I attached a short approval memo for the contract folder. Please route to Finance (cc: accounting) when DocuSign is ready.

-Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joel Park <joel.park@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com; ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-06T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — credits & short-term pricing ask

Joel — quick update and final concession summary attached.

Summary (final):
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to first paid invoice following receipt of PO (Deal: CL-2027-089).
- 12-week price corridor: preserve current committed unit rates for baseline token usage from the invoice date for 12 weeks. Overage above baseline billed at standard overage rate. Corridor expires automatically after 12 weeks.
- Temporary burst pool: we will provision the July pilot; conversion to permanent commit requires 3-month notice with pro-rata pricing.

Next steps:
1) I’m sending the DocuSign packet now: https://www.docusign.net/clearline-cl-089
2) Please have procurement return a PO (reference CL-2027-089) by 2027-05-10 to ensure onboarding credit and corridor apply to the intended invoice.

If procurement needs alternate invoicing language for their AP flow, loop me and Ben directly and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — excited to keep Clearline moving forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: clearline_proposal_v2.pdf; onboarding_credit_calc.xlsx; approval-note.docx
